title: Scaling XGBoost on Databricks
summary: A benchmarking repository comparing XGBoost training efficiency across single-node CPU, distributed CPU (Ray on Spark), and GPU approaches at increasing data scales on Databricks. An experimental notebook uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata to generate synthetic tabular data for scaling experiments.
evidence: notebooks/experimental/generate_ctgan_data.ipynb:127-138 imports CTGANSynthesizer and SingleTableMetadata from sdv, instantiates and trains synthesizer
